title: Love them
text: Love them. I hate when my pillow cases come off during the night. I put these protective zipper covers On Under my other pillow cases and they stayed on nicely. I am a firm believer that all pillow cases should have are zipper!!

product_metadata.title: Simple&Opulence Waterproof Pillow Protectors with Zipper King Size -Set of 2-Hypoallergenic Dustproof White Pillow Cover (20”x36”,2 Pack)
features: 【Material】The front of the pillowcase is 100% cotton, TPU coating on it, and the back side is made of 100% polyester, with a mesh design, which is more breathable. Our pillow covers are lightweight and durable, suitable for all seasons.

【Advantage】Whether you and your family or pets, waterproof protector can be used as a protective layer to your pillow from dust and dirt, prevent the invasion of hair, saliva and sweat, or any other unwanted (reasonably small) particulates. Make your sleeping environment comfortable and noiseless. It is suitable for college dorm, home, hotel, cottage, cabin and other places.
【Zippered Closure】Hidden zipper ensure your sound sleep, no bulge out concern, zips tightly, secures your pillow from all sides. If there is any problem, we will do our best to help you solve it.
【Use Instruction】Machine wash under 30℃ at gentle cycle, tumble day at low heat. Do not bleach; Do not iron; Do not dry clean.
